findings.title: An Arabic hint on the wrong side of the field
findings.message: The placeholder "رمز العرض" is Arabic in a left-to-right field.
findings.fix: Keep dir="ltr" for what people type, and right-align the Arabic hint with input:placeholder-shown { direction: rtl } or ::placeholder { text-align: right }.
findings.snippet: <input type="text" class="promo-input" placeholder="رمز العرض" dir="auto" autocomplete="off">

findings.title: Two digit systems on one screen
findings.message: "١٢:٤٣ ص" uses a different digit system from the rest of the screen.
findings.fix: Pick one digit system for the product and format every number with it.
